cooked: The shared failure mode is attacker-controlled work and allocation without a comparable bound on input size. A useful regression test would assert both a hard decompressed-output limit and a latency or allocation budget for maximum-length feature vectors, so future parser changes don’t reintroduce the same asymmetry.
